{{Quote|Hey, you! Stop! It's the duchess. She's getting away.|The Mandalorian informing his fellow super commandos of the duchess' escape|<ref name="The Lawless" />}}
This '''Mandalorian super commando''' was a member of [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and later sided with [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]].

==Biography==
After building up an army of criminals including the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], and [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his army of criminals [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|attacked]] [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] so the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] could come in and stop them so they could take control of the [[Mandalore/Legends|planet]]. After betraying Maul and the locking him away in [[Royal prison/Legends|Sundari prison]], Maul escaped and returned to [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]] with his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]]. Maul [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], the leader of the Death Watch, and took control of Vizsla's warriors. This [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commando]] was one of the many who aligned with Maul after Vizsla's [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="The Lawless" />

Later, the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] changed their armor to give it a red design to honor the new [[Commanding officer/Legends|leader of the Death Watch]]. This Mandalorian was stationed at the [[Royal prison/Legends|Sundari prison]] and was present when [[Korkie Kryze/Legends|Korkie Kryze]] and his aunt, [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan]] helped [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] escape from the [[Royal prison/Legends|Sundari prison]]. The warrior warned their comrades that the Duchess had escaped. After warning their comrades, the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] took part in the chase after the Duchess.<ref name="The Lawless" />
